data.body: Final store-migration closure evidence: the post-implementation scan (python scripts/migrate_success_criteria.py --repo-root "/Users/joeoakhart/impl-1386-ac-collapse-resume" --include-open) found two newly created open epics that had reintroduced a ## Success Criteria heading after the original 106-ticket migration: 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76 and e369-a449-4773-48fb. Both descriptions were inspected and confirmed to contain legacy heading criteria. Running the same purpose-built migration with --write --include-open reported 'migrated 2 ticket(s)'. A final identical dry-run reported '[dry-run] 0 ticket(s) would be migrated' (twice in summary/detail output), proving the runtime ticket set now has zero remaining legacy headings. These were post-migration reintroductions caught by the epic's final completion close, not omissions from the original batch.
